newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gold oversold, may find interim support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gold oversold, may find interim support.

text.p: SPOT NY CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Overwhelmingly bearish sentiment and downtrending charts continued to pressure gold, whose eventual downside target may be $325-$326, analysts said.
But the market is technically oversold and could manage a bounce from interim support pegged at $328-$330.
GOLD - Prices remained vulnerable to the downside, with the 1993 low of $325.10 an obvious target, analysts said.
Australian producer selling was noted in Asian trading, although short covering helped lift prices off late Thursday's lows.
The 14-day RSI was in oversold territory at 29, which suggested a bounce could be in order. Dealers said interim support for spot gold was evident in the region of $328-$330.
"With technical indicators maintaining their downward bias, expect renewed tests of support at $330/31," said analyst Martin Squires of brokers Rudolf Wolff, referring to Comex August gold.

"If this fails, look to target psychological support at $325.00. However, with the technial indicators now in the oversold band, do not rule out short-term consolidation just above $330.00," he added.
One European trader noted that if gold came off another few dollars the technical scenario would closely resemble that in February, when gold rebounded by some $30 from a low of $336.20.
"I wouldn't want to be aggressively short here. The situation is starting to look similar to earlier this year," the dealer said.
At 0730 GMT spot gold was quoted at $332.20/$332.70 an ounce, up $1.10 from Wednesday's New York close.
SILVER - Prices were supported at $4.60 in the near term, although silver's fate was closely tied to gold, analysts said.
Spot silver was last indicated at $4.65/$4.67, unchanged from Wednesday's New York finish.
PLATINUM - The market was consolidating quietly in a wide $420-$440 band, awaiting long-delayed Russian shipments due on July 10, dealers said.
Platinum was last quoted at $423.00/$426.00, $1.50 higher Wednesday's New York close.
--Lida Poletz, London newsroom +44 171 542 2936
